{{Quote|The palace of Grakkus the Hutt is the most heavily guarded dwelling on the entire Smuggler's Moon.|[[C-3PO]]|<ref name="Star Wars 11">[[Star Wars (2015) 11|''Star Wars'' (2015) 11]]</ref>}}
The '''palace of Grakkus the Hutt''',<ref name="Star Wars 11" /> was located in [[Hutta Town]] on the [[moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa]] and contained numerous relics that once belonged to the [[Jedi Order]]. During his [[time]] on Nar Shaddaa, [[Jedi]] hopeful [[Luke Skywalker]] was captured by [[Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi|Grakkus]] and brought to his palace in order to open the [[Jedi]] [[holocron]]s contained within it.<ref name="Star Wars 9" /> Grakkus kept Skywalker in his custody so the boy could fight an arena match against [[Kongo]] the Disemboweler<ref name="Star Wars 11" /> in [[Grakkus Arena]],<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" /> who Grakkus believed would triumph—allowing the [[Hutt]] to bill the fight as the death of the last Jedi. Skywalker later fought in the arena against Kongo.<ref name="Star Wars 11" />
